hypothesised_pattern: In these rows the target falls with x5 and with x2 and rises with |x4|, so negative x5 together with negative x2 gives high targets even at small x4, while large positive x5 drags the target down even when |x4| is large.
rationale: The highest targets (0.79, 0.65) have x5 = -1.0 and -1.41 together with x2 = -1.69 and -1.55, despite small x4 (0.26, 0.38), while x4 = 0.57 with a similar x5 (-1.46) but x2 = +0.76 gives only 0.40. Rows with large positive x5 are low even with sizeable |x4| (x4 = -1.12, x5 = 1.78 -> 0.31; x4 = 0.64, x5 = 1.42 -> 0.23), whereas x4 = 1.38 with x5 = -0.78 gives 0.61.
